subject: MedPulse pilot: acceptance certification & MAP next steps
messages:

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — need evaluation rubric and MAP

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the KV-cache behavior. Before we commit the PO, legal needs a clearer view into what success looks like for this pilot. Specifically:

- A compact set of acceptance tests we can run during the 6-week pilot
- Absolute exit gates (pass/fail thresholds) and fallback plan if we miss targets

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — MAP + acceptance certification (draft)

Emma — attaching a concise draft that combines a MAP table, owner matrix, and an acceptance certification manifest. Key points up front:

1) Acceptance band (must-pass): throughput >= 150 requests/min sustained for 5m windows; 95th percentile latency <= 220ms for 512-token prompts; model concordance >= 92% on the provided seed set.
2) Exit gate (blocker): any single safety/regulatory failure (PII leakage, audit log gaps) is automatic fail and triggers the fallback plan.
3) Evidence: automated token-level logs, sample transcript set (20 threads flagged by MedPulse), and functional smoke-runbook results.
4) Ownership: Redwood to provide smoke tests, log exports, and a candidate patch for aerosolized inference issues; MedPulse to run behavioral checks and sign off on concordance examples.

Attachments included: medpulse-eval-checklist.xlsx (MAP table + test owners), SOW-draft-v2.docx (commercial + timing).

Can Karthik and Marissa confirm the quantization profile and the SLA language in the SOW? We want to lock the mutual action plan by Aug 3 to meet Emma's procurement deadline.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Petting the draft now. A couple of suggestions (internal):

- Quantization profile: recommend q3f16 for the pilot to hit the latency/throughput bucket; note to include a regression clause: if concordance drops >3% vs baseline on the seed set, revert to fp16 path.
- Add a lightweight canary: first 48 hours limited to 1000 requests/day routed to pilot model only, with automatic rollback on error spike (>2% error rate).
- Clarify the concordance test: define how ties / abstains are scored (we should treat abstains as disagreement for pass/fail).
- SOW: add explicit billing cap for burst GPU hours during the pilot.

I'll inline edits into the SOW and MAP. Marissa — can you validate the evidence artifacts list for compliance (SOC 2 logs, retention window)?

-Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@medpulse.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: MedPulse MAP & Acceptance Certification — finalized and next steps

Emma / Team — thanks for the quick turn. Per the attachments and our small edits, this is the finalized mutual action plan and acceptance certification for the 6-week pilot. Summary of the finalized acceptance tests and exit gates (high level):

- Performance: 95th pctl latency <= 220ms (512 tokens) & throughput >= 150 req/min sustained for 5-minute windows — checked by Redwood telemetry exports.
- Quality: concordance >= 92% on MedPulse seed set of 250 labeled examples. Scoring treats abstains as non-concordant.
- Reliability & Safety: zero instances of PII exfiltration in the sample transcripts and complete audit log coverage for all pilot traffic. Any confirmed PII leakage is a blocking failure.
- Canary & Rollback: first 48-hour canary (1000 req/day cap) with automated rollback on error-rate threshold (>2%) or critical safety flags.
- Billing & Cap: capped burst GPU hours at 120 hours; excess billed at agreed pilot rate with pre-approval.

Owners & artifacts: Redwood provides smoke-runbook results, token-level logs, and a nightly concordance digest; MedPulse provides the seed label set, a signed acceptance declaration, and the behavioral checks.

Next steps:
1) Emma — please confirm acceptance of this MAP by EOD Aug 6 so procurement can proceed.
2) On confirmation, we will schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Aug 9 (09:00 PT) and provide the environment link + onboarding checklist.
3) We will place the SOW and statement-of-work countersign packet into the DocuSign link in the Drive (see link below).

Attachments: medpulse-eval-checklist.xlsx, SOW-draft-v2.docx
Links: https://drive.redwood.internal/medpulse/MAP-v1 (MAP + SOW), https://app.hubspot.com/deals/MP-2028-0423 (deal)

If you want a short two-slide one-pager for procurement summarizing acceptance gates, we can produce that by Monday.
